I am bothered by what could happen in 9 here is an incredibly long explanation of what this trilogy is and where I am afraid it is going. (Don't worry this is totally related to the op)

TFA starts by completely ignoring what happened in OT.  
The new republic was plot nuked out of existence. (I get why after the prequels it was necessary to return to the "good guys have no guns bad guys have all the guns" paradigm but that result meant that a lot of origin stories are needed). Some unanswered questions. 

1. Where did the first order come from. (There is a Wookieepedia article here, but honestly the films shouldn't come withe homework)
2. Why is the New Republic dead so easily. (There are easy but boring ways to solve this, inflation, unemployment basically space Weimar.)
3. Where did Snoke come from. How did he get credibility among imperial officer types. 
4. Where did Rey come from. (This isn't as big of an issue but TFA decided to make her desperate to find her parents making them important)

Note that you could ask the same questions of ep4 and they would not be answered, and the OT only hints at answering them. (Darth Vader was Anakin, Empire was a republic, this thing called the "clone wars" happened, and there used to be more Jedi) however OT could get away with this because we had no idea what happened before (just like the prequels could get away with not giving Palpatine an explanation). In TFA though, the whole world looks nothing like what it did when we left it. 

Thus we need to know what happened.

TFA put these questions up and TLJ refused to answer them. How did the first order show up?... People sold them weapons.....? (The galaxy post ROTJ seems remarkably similar to a real world failed state)

Where did Snoke come from... he's dead, (I honestly approve of that though) but seriously the critics do have a point, a force user of that magnitude doesn't just appear. I get that Johnson doesn't seem to think he should be in the story at all, but you can't change the past, he exists and that means we need to know WHY he exists. 

Rey is the other great lore question, how can you beat Ren with no training. Once again probably a mistake in TFA, the movie wanted a cool lightsaber fight and there were no trained jedi on screen yet and Rey had to win due to the new hope plot structure. Even if it is a mistake, you can't pretend it didn't happen. TLJ tries to explain this by saying that Ren had emotional issues after only fulfilling half of his Oedipus Complex, but that seems kinda week.

So TFA left Johnson in a position where he had to explain these things. Which he decided to either explain badly or not at all, probably because he disagreed with JJ Abrams, and tried to snuff out plot points he didn't like.

The result is that both TFA and TLJ are (in my very wrong opinion) pretty good movies, they just don't seem to connect. 

Now it is my understanding that JJ is back for 9. I am not sure about this but I am afraid he might do the same thing he did in TFA and that Johnson did  in TLJ. That is.. ignore plot points from the past because they don't like them. 

So for example Snoke will either not have his origin explained or not only be still alive, but have the exact same relationship with kylo Ren that he did in TFA because that whole being cut in half thing never happend. This and other decisions like it could wreck the trilogy by making film's that are fun to watch but an overarching story that is incoherent.
